from pathlib import Path
import json

ROOT=Path.home()/'.local/share/prediction-chat-bridge'
TARGET='DEV-PRED-PRODUCTION-SNAPSHOT-EXPORT-CHUNK-20261005-E054'

found=None
where=None
for box in ('inflight','sent','outbox'):
    d=ROOT/box
    if not d.is_dir():
        continue
    for p in sorted(d.glob('*.json'), key=lambda x: x.stat().st_mtime_ns, reverse=True):
        try:
            obj=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8',errors='replace'))
        except Exception:
            continue
        if str(obj.get('task_id') or '')==TARGET:
            found=obj
            where=box
            break
    if found:
        break

if not found:
    print('PREDICTION_SNAPSHOT_EXPORT_V1')
    print('SNAPSHOT_EXPORT_META={"status":"MISSING","target":"'+TARGET+'"}')
    print('SNAPSHOT_EXPORT_DATA=Tk9UX0ZPVU5E')
    raise SystemExit(4)

raw=str(found.get('message') or '')
meta=''
data=''
for line in raw.splitlines():
    if line.startswith('SNAPSHOT_EXPORT_META='):
        meta=line.split('=',1)[1].strip()
    elif line.startswith('SNAPSHOT_EXPORT_DATA='):
        data=line.split('=',1)[1].strip()

if not meta or not data:
    print('PREDICTION_SNAPSHOT_EXPORT_V1')
    print('SNAPSHOT_EXPORT_META={"status":"FIELDS_MISSING","box":"'+where+'"}')
    print('SNAPSHOT_EXPORT_DATA=RklFTERTX01JU1NJTkc=')
    raise SystemExit(5)

print('PREDICTION_SNAPSHOT_EXPORT_V1')
print('SNAPSHOT_EXPORT_META='+meta)
print('SNAPSHOT_EXPORT_DATA='+data)
raise SystemExit(0)
